mapper.select: SELECT id, corpid, business_code AS businessCode, prefix, include_date AS includeDate, suffix_length AS suffixLength, serial_mode AS serialMode, rule_type AS ruleType, del, add_time AS addTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_biz_no_rule WHERE business_code = #{businessCode} AND corpid IN (#{corpid}, '0') AND del = 0 ORDER BY CASE WHEN corpid = #{corpid} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END LIMIT 1

SELECT id, corpid, business_code AS businessCode, prefix, include_date AS includeDate, suffix_length AS suffixLength, serial_mode AS serialMode, rule_type AS ruleType, del, add_time AS addTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_biz_no_rule WHERE corpid = #{corpid} AND business_code = #{businessCode} AND del = 0

SELECT current_rule.id, current_rule.corpid, current_rule.business_code AS businessCode, current_rule.prefix, current_rule.include_date AS includeDate, current_rule.suffix_length AS suffixLength, current_rule.serial_mode AS serialMode, current_rule.rule_type AS ruleType, current_rule.del, current_rule.add_time AS addTime, current_rule.update_time AS updateTime FROM sys_biz_no_rule current_rule WHERE current_rule.corpid IN (#{corpid}, '0') AND current_rule.del = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_biz_no_rule own_rule WHERE own_rule.corpid = #{corpid} AND own_rule.business_code = current_rule.business_code AND own_rule.del = 0 AND current_rule.corpid = '0' ) ORDER BY current_rule.rule_type, current_rule.business_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_biz_no_rule (corpid, business_code, prefix, include_date, suffix_length, serial_mode, rule_type, del, add_time, update_time) VALUES (#{corpid}, #{businessCode}, #{prefix}, #{includeDate}, #{suffixLength}, #{serialMode}, #{ruleType}, #{del}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime})
